assessments.quote: All INR 100 crore was allocated: INR 60 crore to solar and INR 40 crore to rail.
assessments.justification: The full amount is split between both eligible sectors.

assessments.quote: The closing unallocated balance was zero.
assessments.justification: The issuer discloses a zero closing balance, so there is no interim balance to manage.

assessments.quote: Riverline Electric Railway, East District: INR 40 crore for rail electrification.
assessments.justification: Named projects have a sector, location and allocation; Riverline is one example.
The issuer does not map the sectors to its own framework and a standard.

assessments.quote: The framework excludes coal, oil and gas infrastructure.
assessments.justification: The issuer identifies three types of excluded infrastructure.

assessments.quote: Sunfield generated 90,000 MWh. Riverline electrified 18 km of railway.
assessments.justification: There is a quantified output for each financed category.

assessments.quote: Solar avoided emissions use a baseline grid factor of 0.7 tCO2e per MWh.
assessments.justification: The disclosure names the solar baseline factor but gives limited assumptions and boundaries.

assessments.quote: Solar avoided emissions use a baseline grid factor of 0.7 tCO2e per MWh.
assessments.justification: An explicit reference grid factor is supplied for solar.
No earlier reporting period is available for comparison.

assessments.quote: This inaugural report uses the ICMA Harmonised Framework for Impact Reporting.
assessments.justification: The report identifies an impact reporting framework.

assessments.quote: Sunfield generated 90,000 MWh. Riverline electrified 18 km of railway.
assessments.justification: The two outputs are attributed to separate projects.

assessments.quote: In the absence of bond financing, both projects would have proceeded on schedule.
assessments.justification: The issuer explicitly describes what would have happened without the bond.

assessments.quote: We claim no incremental access to finance from this issue.
assessments.justification: The issuer explicitly disclaims incremental financing.
No business-as-usual environmental performance comparison is supplied.

assessments.quote: Sunfield generated 90,000 MWh. Riverline electrified 18 km of railway.
assessments.justification: Named project outputs are reported, but the contribution of financing is uncertain.

assessments.quote: No external review of the framework or this report was commissioned.
assessments.justification: The report explicitly states that no external review was commissioned.
There is no reviewer whose credentials can be assessed.
There is no verification engagement whose scope can be assessed.

assessments.quote: The Green Bond Committee approves eligible expenditure each quarter.
assessments.justification: A named committee approves eligible expenditure on a specified schedule.
There is no evidence on issuer-verifier conflicts.
Possession of this document does not establish public accessibility.

assessments.quote: Reporting period: year ended 31 March 2025. Published: 30 June 2025.
assessments.justification: The publication date is three months after year-end.
No accompanying machine-readable dataset is available in this input.

assessments.quote: The issuer will publish an annual impact report until bond maturity.
assessments.justification: Annual impact reporting is promised for the full tenor.

assessments.quote: Land acquisition at Riverline displaced two businesses; compensation is pending.
assessments.justification: The report identifies displacement and outstanding compensation.

assessments.quote: Stakeholders may submit grievances to the Treasury complaints desk.
assessments.justification: A Treasury complaints desk is available for stakeholder concerns.
